assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original transparent PNG feature icon for the Mac OS 9 / Platinum skin of AvaMedia.
Input image 1 is the new Mac OS 9 rotate icon and defines this independent set's pixel-art contour, scale, highlights and palette. Input image 2 is the older feature-icon sheet: meanings of symbols only, do not copy its smooth modern illustration style or labels.
Match reference 1 as a coherent late-1990s hand-pixelled desktop utility family. Design on a small 48 by 48 pixel logical grid, displayed as an enlarged clean pixel-art illustration. Hard square pixel steps, one logical pixel near-black/dark-gray outlines, restrained white edge highlights, few broad flat two-tone shaded regions. Almost frontal, square film sprocket holes, crisp readable shapes. Neutral Platinum silver-gray, medium blue panels, medium green notes/arrows, muted golden-orange gears/play controls, coral-red scissors handles/record dot when appropriate. Favor reference 1's squared edges and gray body over the older sheet's cyan body and rounded glossy bevels. Single centered illustration filling about 80% of square canvas, balanced with rotate icon, generous transparent padding. Clear at 32–48 pixels on #CCCCCC gray.
True alpha transparency around the whole symbol and in empty spaces. Original artwork, no Apple logo or copied system icon. No letters or text (except standard lowercase i for information), labels, watermark, screenshot, contact sheet, opaque background, background plate, drawn checkerboard, modern rounded app tile, photorealism, blur, smooth vector curves, gradients, or soft shadows. Exactly ONE icon.
Primary request: VIDEO FORMAT CONVERSION icon. Subject: a tall white and Platinum silver-gray document sheet with a folded top-right corner, containing one dark charcoal filmstrip with medium blue panels in the lower two thirds. Leave the upper quarter of the sheet empty to support an application-rendered format badge. No badge and no text should be drawn into this PNG.

Input image 1 is the new Mac OS 9 rotate icon and defines this independent set's pixel-art contour, scale, highlights and palette. Input image 2 is the older feature-icon sheet: meanings of symbols only, do not copy its smooth modern illustration style or labels.
Match reference 1 as a coherent late-1990s hand-pixelled desktop utility family. Design on a small 48 by 48 pixel logical grid, displayed as an enlarged clean pixel-art illustration. Hard square pixel steps, one logical pixel near-black/dark-gray outlines, restrained white edge highlights, few broad flat two-tone shaded regions. Almost frontal, square film sprocket holes, crisp readable shapes. Neutral Platinum silver-gray, medium blue panels, medium green notes/arrows, muted golden-orange gears/play controls, coral-red scissors handles/record dot when appropriate. Favor reference 1's squared edges and gray body over the older sheet's cyan body and rounded glossy bevels. Single centered illustration filling about 80% of square canvas, balanced with rotate icon, generous transparent padding. Clear at 32–48 pixels on #CCCCCC gray.
True alpha transparency around the whole symbol and in empty spaces. Original artwork, no Apple logo or copied system icon. No letters or text (except standard lowercase i for information), labels, watermark, screenshot, contact sheet, opaque background, background plate, drawn checkerboard, modern rounded app tile, photorealism, blur, smooth vector curves, gradients, or soft shadows. Exactly ONE icon.
Primary request: MEDIA INFORMATION icon. Subject: one clear medium blue-blue circular information button with a subtle silver outer rim and a clearly centered white lowercase information i symbol, simple rounded vertical stem and separate round dot. This standard i symbol is the ONLY permitted letter; no other text or caption. One circle only, no paper sheet.

optimization.method: Lanczos resize and optimized RGBA PNG
